title: WORKSHEET 55
subject: Certainty, Possibility, Impossibility and Advisability
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 55: Certainty, Possibility, Impossibility and Advisability

sections.instruction: Rewrite the sentences using the modals of CERTAINTY, IMPOSSIBILITY and POSSIBILITY:
